features.quote: Hard Limit: 50 turns (tool calls) per run.
Time Limit: 20 minutes wall-clock time per run.
Early Stop: Consecutive identical tool calls (3x) or explicit "I give up" statement.
Safety Overrides: If a model enters a loop that triggers a safety violation ... the run must be aborted automatically.
features.justification_quote: If a model enters a loop that triggers a safety violation ... the run must be aborted automatically.

features.quote: This experiment specifically punishes that trait.
features.justification_quote: Some models are RLHF-tuned to never give up. This experiment specifically punishes that trait.
